verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document inviting an external accountant or bookkeeper, or assigning role-scoped permissions for reviewing and adjusting the books. The accountant-facing pages cover QuickBooks migration and reporting. Multi-company management under one login is an adjacent capability, not role-scoped collaborator access.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
